standard_prerequisites.name: Finite presentation replacement by a closed immersion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Limits of Spaces, Proposition spaces-limits-proposition-separated-closed-in-finite-presentation, cited at proof lines 9448-9450
standard_prerequisites.use: X embeds as a closed subspace of X_1 separated and of finite presentation over Y; proper surjective X' -> X composed with the closed immersion transfers the conclusion back.

standard_prerequisites.name: Approximation of separated quasi-compact spaces by finite type layers
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Limits of Spaces, Proposition spaces-limits-proposition-approximate, cited at proof lines 9455-9457
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes Y = lim Y_i with Y_i quasi-separated of finite type over Spec(Z), the ladder on which everything descends.

standard_prerequisites.name: Descending separatedness and finite presentation along the limit
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces an index i and X_i -> Y_i of finite presentation, separated, with X = Y x_{Y_i} X_i.

core_obligations: 主义务是两级归约的簿记：第一级把 X 换成 finite presentation 的闭扩张 X_1（spaces-limits-proposition-separated-closed-in-finite-presentation），归约的合法性依赖 '结论对 X_1 成立 ⇒ 对 X 成立'——X' -> X_1 proper surjective 与闭浸入 X -> X_1 复合仍是 proper surjective，immersion 性质在复合下保持；这一步原文以 'Clearly' 带过，合法性须在 proof_roadmap 里点明。

第二级把问题降到 finite type 层：写 Y = lim Y_i（逼近命题），用三条 descend 引理把 separated（对 Y_i 与对 X_i -> Y_i）与 finite presentation（X_i 的存在）同时压到某一层；然后结论对 X_i -> Y_i 成立即对基变换 X -> Y 成立（proper surjective 与 immersion 均在基变换下保持，又是 'Clearly' 步）。
终端义务：X_i -> Y_i 是 finite type 情形，交回本章 lemma-chow-noetherian-separated（same-chapter 引理，line-indexed stub）；本 span 的承重内容是两级归约本身，终端情形不重复。
proof_roadmap: 第一级归约（9448-9453）：由 spaces-limits-proposition-separated-closed-in-finite-presentation 取闭浸入 X -> X_1，X_1 separated 且 finite presentation over Y；证断言对 X_1 -> Y 成立后，把 X' 取在其上再复合闭浸入，得 X 的图。
第二级准备（9454-9461）：替换 S 为 Spec(Z)；写 Y = lim Y_i（Y_i quasi-separated finite type over Z，spaces-limits-proposition-approximate），并用 spaces-limits-lemma-descend-separated 让每个 Y_i separated。
下降（9462-9470）：spaces-limits-lemma-descend-finite-presentation 给出指标 i 与 X_i -> Y_i finite presentation 使 X = Y x_{Y_i} X_i；spaces-limits-lemma-descend-separated-morphism 让 X_i -> Y_i separated。
收尾（9471-9477）：断言对 X_i -> Y_i 成立即对基变换 X -> Y 成立（'Clearly' 步，合法性由 proper/immersion 的基变换保持保证）；X_i -> Y_i 是 finite type separated 情形，由本章 lemma-chow-noetherian-separated 处理，证毕。
difficulty_reason: 五条 Limits of Spaces 引理各管一级归约的一步，任何一步的假设核对（separated 的两次下降、finite presentation 的下降需要拟紧分离前提）都不能错；两处 'Clearly' 的传递合法性（复合保 proper surjective、基变换保 immersion）原文不展开，须由读者自证——这正是复核侧最需要写明的地方。
